verdict.rationale: Vendor material only vaguely gestures at gaming ('games like Control look more compelling' via ray-tracing) with no FPS figures, no game benchmark suite results, and no independent frame-rate testing to corroborate; one community comment even flags Windows-ecosystem game dev as still 'sluggish' on Apple silicon. Missing for 10: actual frame-rate/game benchmark data, independent reviewer gaming tests, and vendor gaming performance claims beyond a single anecdotal visual reference.
